notes: H0 uses the native minimal agent loop and compaction. Authentication, container tool transport, and bounded model-request recovery are fixed infrastructure. Connection failures, interrupted streams, and service overload retry the failed model step or compaction after 2, 5, 20, 30, 60 seconds within the original deadline and budget. Completed tools are not replayed. Each bash call starts in /app; files persist, shell state does not. Host filesystem tools are disabled. No task-solving hints, reminders, whole-trial retries, or submission repair.
